simple.meaning: יַרְכָא (yarkâʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a thigh.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Daniel 2:32. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יַרְכָא (H3410) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: יַרְכָא (yarkâʼ) / H3410 is traced through Daniel 2:32 with generated occurrence evidence.
